_meta.source: Municipal utility supply portfolios, researched + cited per metro (utility/state/USGS documents, ~2024-2025 mixes)
_meta.method: share by source type per metro, rounded to 0.05, sums to 1.0; confidence high/medium per metro; citations inline
_meta.caveats: shares are approximate and vary year-to-year (esp. CA/AZ); imported shares reflect normal years; used by resilienceScore.ts waterScore as the access-weighted portfolio
